title: Cauliflower and Mild Cheddar Bisque
description: Pureed cauliflower carries melted cheddar in a velvety bisque.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.text: Break {caul} into small florets and thinly slice peeled {potato}.

steps.title: Set up the pot
steps.text: Use the enamel Dutch oven on a medium burner; adjust the flame to hold a bare simmer.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Melt {butter} and sweat the cauliflower for 4 minutes over medium-low heat.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the potatoes and {broth}. Cover and simmer 18–22 minutes until very soft. Blend carefully to a smooth base.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return to gentle heat with {milk}; when hot, remove from heat and whisk in {cheddar} and {mustard}.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in meal-size containers for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: stir over medium-low heat to 165°F, adding a splash of water as needed. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat to 165°F. Dairy swap: replace each dairy ingredient with unsweetened oat milk or an equivalent dairy-free butter or cheese. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 191 kcal, 10.9 g protein, 17.8 g total carbohydrate, 9.4 g fat, 3.4 g fiber, 211 mg sodium.
